here's a nuance worth understanding on BC sites. You arrive at a former industrial site where the client
wants to install solar arrays under power smart 2.0 while completing a risk assessment under the CSR.
The solar footprint overlaps with areas previously flagged for soil vapor intrusion monitoring.

standalone capital project rather than integrating it into the remedial design report from the outset.

the incentive application. If you're working on transportation sector emissions assessments,
